title: Primordial Curse / Forsaken Wonder
problem: Primordial Curse / Forsaken Wonder: stop 'lasts forever' landing on the wrong creature (debuffs on your own Relic / Synchronicity creature became permanent). In-game confirmed bug. Partial fix: the intended 'Relic-inflicted lasts forever' needs a hook (H01b)

verified_in_game.result: partial: spread works (unchanged, was never broken); permanence on your own Avatar holding its own god's Relic is gone (fixed); Relic-inflicted debuffs / Relic-granted buffs are NOT permanent (expected: needs H01b hook)

history.result: v2 crashed (no error dialog) on the first spell cast from an Avatar. Cause: cave code used absolute addresses, invalid under ASLR. v3: logic moved to a C hook in the loader (trampoline via pointer slot), absolute-address guard added to the builder.

v3 works: buffs and debuffs on the primary target are permanent, on either side (consistent with the text, which sets no side limit). Spread copies were not permanent: they are created with source -1 and default duration. v4: spread copies get duration -2; source stays -1 so they can't re-spread.

notes: Details: research/handoff_eval.md Community/vet: Community claim: The "buffs last forever" part doesn't work. Evidence: scr_CritAddCondition: scr_PerkLevel(655, holder.slot == 0 ? 1 : 0) @0x142017016 / 0x1420170da -> duration := -2 @0x1420170f3. Fix sketch: S: swap the two side constants (testing the inflicter as the text says needs H) 2026-10-26 in-game test (user): H01 behaves as designed; the intended permanence needs H01b (set the event duration to -2 in bc_EventDebuff / bc_EventBuff when the source is the Relic pseudo-creature or passes scr_CritHasAncientSyn, perk 654/655 is owned, and the target is on the opposite / same side). 2026-10-26 v2 (tools/build_h01b.py): hook replaces the partial fix. The 3 buff/debuff event sites in bc_ExecuteEvents pass the event's source to scr_CritAddCondition's own Curse/Wonder checks (holder slot swapped with the inflicter for the duration of those two blocks); adds that don't come from an event, or with no source, skip the blocks; Wonder side constants fixed; the game's own duration = -2 writes restored. Limitation: start-of-battle / 'always has' adds have no event, so they get no permanence. Awaiting the user's in-game re-test. v3 2026-10-26: C hook (loader/hooks.c) + trampoline; awaiting re-test. v4 2026-10-26: spread copies permanent (duration -2). Finding for the extract (PERK_SIGNATURES.md Open item): the spread copies are sourced -1. | 2026-10-26 (batch K, SU-0216): the 'partial' is closed. The start-of-battle Relic buffs (Arbiter, Ferro, Prime & Ventus, Salus, Triumvir, Whisper; Forsaken Wonder) and Blazefury 40's start-of-battle Burning (Primordial Curse) get duration -2 through SU-0216's hooks on those direct adds; 'always has' adds already pass -2 (and are re-added when missing). The start-of-battle permanence therefore needs SU-0216 switched on. No double spread: SU-0080's hook still covers only the three event sites, and SU-0216's spread copies are source -1 events.

release_notes.intended: Debuffs inflicted (or buffs granted) by your creatures' Relics last forever and spread to all other enemies (or allies).
release_notes.actual: In the unpatched game, the 'lasts forever' landed on the wrong creature (e.g. debuffs on your own Relic creature became permanent) and the Relic's own debuffs and buffs did not.
release_notes.fix: Now Relic debuffs and buffs (including Ancient Synchronicity creatures) and their spread copies last forever, including the ones Relics give at the start of battle.
